text:
The niece takes nothing. Under most modern statutes, "to cousin and the heirs of his body" creates a fee tail that converts to a fee simple absolute in the cousin, so the uncle kept no reversion to convey and the deed to his niece passes no interest. Only in the minority of states that still recognize fee tails would she hold a future reversion, and that is not the majority rule the question asks about.

CONFIDENCE: 85
